title: Elf Bar Elfx Pro Classic Edition Pod Vape Kit
description: The Elf Bar Elfx Pro Classic Edition Pod Kit delivers the perfect balance of style, innovation, and performance in a compact and versatile device. Crafted from premium zinc alloy with naturally-derived vegan leather, the Elfx Pro combines durability with an elegant finish. Its 0.96” colour display and intuitive multi-function buttons allow effortless control over adjustable power (5-45W), mode selection, and an array of device settings. Powered by a 1200mAh rechargeable battery, the Elfx Pro supports Turbo Mode for bold flavour bursts and Eco Mode for extended battery life, catering to your every vaping need. Engineered for minimal downtime, the Elfx Pro can reach 80% battery in just 30 minutes via its USB-C port and supports pass-through vaping for uninterrupted sessions. Safety is a priority, with features including overcharge protection, low battery protection, and short-circuit protection. The device features advanced dual mesh coil technology, optimised for consistent vapour production and bold flavour. The 2ml refillable pod incorporates a side-fill system for easy, mess-free refills and is built with a 4-layer anti-leak structure for added reliability. The kit includes a 0.6ohm pod ideal for smooth RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping with 50/50 and Nic Salt e-liquids, and a 0.8ohm pod for a more intense and tactile MTL (mouth-to-lung) experience with 50/50, High-PG and Nic Salt e-liquids. Available in a range of striking colours including Black, White, Cowboy Brown, Cowboy Gray, Forest, Orange, and Pink, and wrapped in luxurious vegan leather, the Elf Bar Elfx Pro Classic Edition Pod Kit is the ideal companion for both new and experienced vapers seeking a reliable, feature-rich device that oozes premium class. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
